name: agent-coding-workflow

managed.description: Whole skill directories, including references, scripts and tests. Upgraded only when unmodified since install.
Role templates for a selected runtime. Existing different files require explicit resolution.
Project-specific facts filled from the actual project. Never overwritten on upgrade.
Only the marked block is maintained. Content outside it is project-owned.

unmanaged: skills/*/references/sources.md upstream attribution remains inside copied skills

codex.isolation: sandbox_mode = read-only for reviewer and oracle; workspace-write for implementer

zcode.isolation: role instruction only; Bash tool is not a read-only sandbox

pi.isolation: role instruction plus defaultContext fresh for reviewer; Bash is not a read-only sandbox

excludedFromDistribution: Project-specific documents, tests, CI, deployment configuration
